description: This Java source file defines the 'ThingModifyCommandAdapter' class, which acts as an adapter for mapping 'ThingModifyCommand' objects to and from 'Adaptable' objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It implements conversion logic utilizing signal mappers and mapping strategies tailored for 'ThingModifyCommand' commands.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandAdapter
classes.description: Final class that extends 'AbstractThingAdapter' and implements 'ModifyCommandAdapter' for 'ThingModifyCommand' objects, facilitating conversion between commands and 'Adaptable' representations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method returning a new instance of 'ThingModifyCommandAdapter' with a provided 'HeaderTranslator'.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a 'ThingModifyCommand' and a 'TopicPath.Channel' into an 'Adaptable' using the internal 'signalMapper'.
